description: This Java class 'RemoveUnneededTraces' is designed to analyze and optimize PCB layout files by removing unused segments and vias from a PCB data structure, represented by PcbNode and related classes.

classes.name: RemoveUnneededTraces
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to optimize PCB layout by removing unused segments and vias.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that takes input and output file paths, then calls optimize.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Reads PCB data from input file, removes unused segments and vias, and writes to output file.

methods.name: removeUnusedVias
methods.description: Removes vias that are not connected to any segment, based on specific criteria.

methods.name: findUnusedVias
methods.description: Finds vias that are unused based on connection counts.

methods.name: removeUnusedSegments
methods.description: Removes segments that are deemed unused based on connectivity analysis.

methods.name: findUnusedSegments
methods.description: Identifies segments that are not connected to modules or other segments.

methods.name: isUnused
methods.description: Determines if a segment is unused by checking connectivity of start and end points.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a point is connected to other segments or modules.
